name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Serpentine Owl

text.plain: A Figurine of Wondrous Power is a pocket-sized statuette that becomes its specified living creature when thrown to the ground with a Magic action. This serpentine statuette of an owl can become a Giant Owl for up to 8 hours and can communicate telepathically with you on the same plane. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 2 days have passed.
